Takedown.item Description:
The holder of this item must take 4 drinks,
will lose 4 points. They will in turn,
 have a slightly higher chance
 of items spawning next round.

The Lefty.item Description:
The holder must drink for every 
player who has a left hand,
+ left handed rage.

Pahdrinko-Reverse.item Description:
The item holder gets to give a drink
for every drink they're given by items/players
for the next 2 rounds

Old Baller.item Description:
The item holder must drink the player age gap
+Ball hops, +old guy rage

Royally Boned.item Description:
The item holder will have to 
drink with every player until someone takes an item.
 +4 points, better item spawn chance

Los Admos.item Description:
The item holder will be forced to pay
LA rent prices in balls. 
They can also give 2 drinks.

The Bob Mayer.item Description:
For every physical feature the item holder
shares with Bob, give 2 drinks.
+ gamer rage, +4 balls, and take 2 drinks.

Gamer Doughnut.item Description:
The holder's balls will weigh as much
as Doughnut next turn. + 2 balls, - 1 point.

The Craziest Place.item Description:
What's the craziest place you
ever made whoopie? The item holder
must answer honestly or take 2 drinks.
+ Sponge and whoopie luck

Narrative Context.item Description:
The item reciever must pick a topic, 
then following list order players must state a fact about it. 
The first person to be assumed of a lie or repeat
 must take this item and 3 drinks.

Bamblain Knowledge.item Description:
The item reciever must pick a game,
then following list order players must quickly say a relevant fact.
The first person to repeat or mess up
will get this item and 3 drinks.

Prepare For Trouble.item Description:
The item holder must take 1 drink, 
but for as long as they're drinking, 
everyone else must also drink. 
-3 points from item holder.

The Law.item Description:
The item holder must make a new law, 
which will be in effect until the end of the game. 
When the law is broken, the law breaker must take 2 drinks. 
-2 points from the item holder every round.

The Games Dean Decree.item Description:
As the new Dean of Games, the item holder
makes a new rule that ends after their next turn.
Breaking the rule = take a drink.
+3 balls to everyone except for the item holder.
 Increased item spawn liklihood.

Have You Logged Your Hours?!.item Description:
The holder of this item has been caught by
the naughty gamer police! They must pay 10 balls
and take 2 drinks + violent shake.

What's Up Gamers.item Description:
The holder of this item must describe
an embarassing public speaking moment they
experienced. Then take 2 drinks, + 4 points.

Where Are You!.item Description:
Oh no, Patrick really wants to know where
you are! The item holder must play it safe,
 and can only drop 5 balls next turn. +4 balls.

Chef Katrina.item Description:
'What's cookin good lookin'' she says!
The item holder takes 4 drinks to prepare
for the feast of mini-corns and losing at fortnite.
Increased item spawn liklihood.

Gamer College Alumni.item Description:
Ah a risk taker I see!
The holder of this item pays 12 points for 12 balls.
+ Take and give 2 drinks

I'm Polyamerous *dabs*.item Description:
The holder of this item must matchmake
a dreamy polyamorous couple. At least 1 member
 must be a shared acquaintance/player. + 4 balls.

Tessable.item Description:
The holder of this item has to
describe a hottest anime boy or book character. 
+violence, +5 balls, give 2 drinks.

The Mean Streets Of Burlington, VT.item Description:
The holder of this item will be confronted
by the Burly boys. They'll lose 4 balls,
have no items spawn next turn, but gain gamer rage.

Fishy David.item Description:
The item holder gets to give 3 drinks,
but if they say the words dublin, ireland, or fish
 for the rest of the game, they must take 3.

Udder Danger.item Description:
Item holder's balls get moon bounce, and will
hop from peg to peg with grace and elegance.
 + 4 balls, 2 drinks, and bounce.

their balls swapped with {x}.

Chauncey T Beaver.item Description:
Chauncey's luck is legendary; it's said
beating the suit wearer to death absorbs
their essence. Holder: Who would
{x} put in the suit. +2 points

Dark Chauncey.item Description:
The spirit of Dark Chauncey possesses the balls
and uses them for evil. No items spawn,
-10 points, +5 balls, give 2 drinks.
Dark Chauncey.item Modifier: Switch Random Player Balls With Someone Else

The Golden Chaunce.item Description:
The Golden Chauncey holder shall drop 1 ball,
but he shall reward its holder ten-fold. 
Take 2 drinks.

The Egg Lord.item Description:
The egg lord shall turn the holder's balls
into his evil minions.
Holder gives up 4 balls, and gains chaos.
